units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|name|215|0
units.english: Defeat Riiria and return
units.italian: Sconfiggi Riiria e torna

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|description|216|0
units.english: If possible, retrieve the stolen wedding gifts from Riiria and return, gifts or not, to House Myurej at <destination>.
units.italian: Se possibile, recupera da Riiria i regali di nozze rubati e torna, con o senza i regali, da Casa Myurej su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|The <ship>'s scanners spring to life not long after you enter <origin>'s atmosphere, pinging several unidentified ships in a nearby valley under the shroud of the thick clouds. As the winds buffet your ship, you check the scan readings you're receiving against the data that Myurej provided you, and they seem to match, at least for the largest of the vessels.|223|0
units.english: The <ship>'s scanners spring to life not long after you enter <origin>'s atmosphere, pinging several unidentified ships in a nearby valley under the shroud of the thick clouds. As the winds buffet your ship, you check the scan readings you're receiving against the data that Myurej provided you, and they seem to match, at least for the largest of the vessels.
units.italian: Gli scanner della <ship> si risvegliano poco dopo che entri nell'atmosfera di <origin>, segnalando diverse navi non identificate in una valle vicina, sotto il velo di nubi spesse. Mentre i venti sferzano la tua nave, confronti le letture che ricevi con i dati forniti da Myurej, e sembrano corrispondere, almeno per la più grande delle navi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	(Attack them while you have the element of surprise.)|225|0
units.english: (Attack them while you have the element of surprise.)
units.italian: (Attaccali finché hai il vantaggio della sorpresa.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	(Try to negotiate.)|226|0
units.english: (Try to negotiate.)
units.italian: (Prova a negoziare.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	As you bring your own vessel closer, you are suddenly thrown off course by a strong gust of wind. Though you regain attitude control only a moment later, it's long enough for Riiria's ships to detect you and prepare for launch...|227|0
units.english: As you bring your own vessel closer, you are suddenly thrown off course by a strong gust of wind. Though you regain attitude control only a moment later, it's long enough for Riiria's ships to detect you and prepare for launch...
units.italian: Mentre avvicini la tua nave, una forte raffica di vento ti sbalza all'improvviso fuori rotta. Riprendi il controllo dell'assetto solo un momento dopo, ma basta perché le navi di Riiria ti individuino e si preparino al decollo...

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|government|230|0
units.english: People's Houses (Hostile)
units.italian: People's Houses (Hostile)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|log|236|0
units.english: Boarded Riiria's vessel, before being forced back by explosions from within that destroyed both Riiria's ship and the wedding gifts it presumably carried.
units.italian: Sei salito a bordo della nave di Riiria, prima di essere respinto dalle esplosioni interne che hanno distrutto sia la nave di Riiria sia i regali di nozze che presumibilmente trasportava.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|You bring your ship alongside Riiria's disabled vessel, careful to line up one of your airlocks with the ship's cargo hatch. As you walk through your vessel's interior to prepare to start cutting through the hatch, however, your ship is rocked by an explosion that seems like it comes from the airlock. Seconds later, another one goes off, and then another. Racing back to your ship's bridge, you detach from the detonating vessel just as another explosion rips through its cargo bay, no doubt destroying the precious cargo you've gone to so much effort to track down. This is going to be unpleasant to explain to House Myurej.|237|0
units.english: You bring your ship alongside Riiria's disabled vessel, careful to line up one of your airlocks with the ship's cargo hatch. As you walk through your vessel's interior to prepare to start cutting through the hatch, however, your ship is rocked by an explosion that seems like it comes from the airlock. Seconds later, another one goes off, and then another. Racing back to your ship's bridge, you detach from the detonating vessel just as another explosion rips through its cargo bay, no doubt destroying the precious cargo you've gone to so much effort to track down. This is going to be unpleasant to explain to House Myurej.
units.italian: Affianchi la nave di Riiria, ormai inattiva, attento ad allineare uno dei tuoi boccaporti alla porta di carico. Mentre attraversi l'interno della tua nave per prepararti a tagliare la porta, però, un'esplosione scuote lo scafo: sembra venire dal boccaporto. Pochi secondi dopo ne scoppia un'altra, e poi un'altra ancora. Corri verso la plancia e ti stacchi dalla nave che esplode proprio mentre un'altra deflagrazione squarcia la sua stiva, distruggendo senza dubbio il prezioso carico che ti sei tanto sforzato di rintracciare. Spiegarlo a Casa Myurej non sarà piacevole.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|government|240|0
units.english: People's Houses (Hostile)
units.italian: People's Houses (Hostile)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|Traffic control directs you to a restricted part of the <planet> spaceport where the bare industry of the public areas gives way to Myurej ostentation. The <ship> settles down on a bronze-edged landing pad, and as you disembark, the armed and armored guards direct you to one of the adjoining buildings. Inside, the room you are led to is divided in much the same way as the previous time you met with House Myurej; a long black screen waves in front of you, and you wait for the voice to begin.|249|0
units.english: Traffic control directs you to a restricted part of the <planet> spaceport where the bare industry of the public areas gives way to Myurej ostentation. The <ship> settles down on a bronze-edged landing pad, and as you disembark, the armed and armored guards direct you to one of the adjoining buildings. Inside, the room you are led to is divided in much the same way as the previous time you met with House Myurej; a long black screen waves in front of you, and you wait for the voice to begin.
units.italian: Il controllo del traffico ti indirizza a una parte riservata dello spazioporto di <planet>, dove all'industria spoglia delle aree pubbliche subentra l'ostentazione di Myurej. La <ship> si posa su una piazzola dai bordi di bronzo e, mentre scendi, le guardie armate e corazzate ti indicano uno degli edifici adiacenti. Dentro, la stanza in cui ti conducono è divisa più o meno come l'altra volta che hai incontrato Casa Myurej: un lungo schermo nero ondeggia davanti a te, e aspetti che la voce cominci.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"We gave thee a simple task," it says. "Yet it seems even aught so basic eludes thee." They pause for a moment.|250|0
units.english: "We gave thee a simple task," it says. "Yet it seems even aught so basic eludes thee." They pause for a moment.
units.italian: "Ti avevamo dato un compito semplice," dice. "Eppure sembra che persino una cosa così elementare ti sfugga." Poi tace per un momento.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"Mayhaps we should have learned from thy failure with Sioeora. Thou hast a habit, it seems to us."|253|0
units.english: "Mayhaps we should have learned from thy failure with Sioeora. Thou hast a habit, it seems to us."
units.italian: "Forse avremmo dovuto imparare dal tuo fallimento con Sioeora. Hai un'abitudine, ci pare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"I had nothing to do with Riiria's ship exploding."|256|0
units.english: "I had nothing to do with Riiria's ship exploding."
units.italian: "Non ho nulla a che fare con l'esplosione della nave di Riiria."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"It seems to me like you're the one who needs to apologize. I was nearly killed!"|257|0
units.english: "It seems to me like you're the one who needs to apologize. I was nearly killed!"
units.italian: "Mi sembra che sia tu quello che deve scusarsi. Sono quasi morto!"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"I'm sorry."|259|0
units.english: "I'm sorry."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	The screen ripples colorlessly. "What careth we? If we had sent another, would it still have been so?"|261|0
units.english: The screen ripples colorlessly. "What careth we? If we had sent another, would it still have been so?"
units.italian: Lo schermo ondeggia senza colore. "Che ce ne importa? Se avessimo mandato un altro, sarebbe andata diversamente?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	The screen ripples, dark and menacing. "Taking missions as these is what thou dost, is it not so? Is it common among lesser aliens as thee to berate one's clients for daring t'offer employ?"|264|0
units.english: The screen ripples, dark and menacing. "Taking missions as these is what thou dost, is it not so? Is it common among lesser aliens as thee to berate one's clients for daring t'offer employ?"
units.italian: Lo schermo ondeggia, scuro e minaccioso. "Prendere incarichi come questo è ciò che fai, non è così? È forse comune tra gli stranieri minori, come te, rimproverare i propri committenti perché osano offrire lavoro?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	The screen ripples, lightless as tar. "We care little for thy apologies," says the voice, "but 'tis good that thou hast some cognizance of thine inability."|267|0
units.english: The screen ripples, lightless as tar. "We care little for thy apologies," says the voice, "but 'tis good that thou hast some cognizance of thine inability."
units.italian: Lo schermo ondeggia, privo di luce come il catrame. "Le tue scuse ci interessano poco," dice la voce, "ma è bene che tu abbia un qualche sentore della tua incapacità."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	Suddenly, a wave of color springs across the screen. When the voice continues, there's something in it you can't quite place. "Thou couldst undo this failure for us, though, Captain. Find us some replacement for the things thou hast lost in thy folly. Thou couldst still earn our coin, our gratitude. Surely thou shouldst leap at this."|269|0
units.english: Suddenly, a wave of color springs across the screen. When the voice continues, there's something in it you can't quite place. "Thou couldst undo this failure for us, though, Captain. Find us some replacement for the things thou hast lost in thy folly. Thou couldst still earn our coin, our gratitude. Surely thou shouldst leap at this."
units.italian: All'improvviso un'onda di colore guizza sullo schermo. Quando la voce riprende, c'è qualcosa che non sai bene collocare. "Potresti però rimediare a questo fallimento, capitano. Trovaci qualcosa che sostituisca ciò che hai perduto nella tua follia. Potresti ancora guadagnarti il nostro denaro, la nostra gratitudine. Di certo dovresti cogliere l'occasione."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"Are you kidding me? I'm done with you."|271|0
units.english: "Are you kidding me? I'm done with you."
units.italian: "Mi stai prendendo in giro? Con te ho chiuso."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"Fine. Tell me more."|272|0
units.english: "Fine. Tell me more."
units.italian: "Va bene. Dimmi di più."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	Something pulses in your ears, driving a momentary prick of pain deep into your head; you realize it's the translation device, picking up on something else in the room, some other bit of imperceptible sound murmuring in the background. The voice interrupts it. "We know what thou desirest, Captain," it says. "To be a part of the events to come, thou shalt need the backing of the Houses. None comes to pass in this space without our blessing. Cry and bark as thou must, thou still requirest us."|274|0
units.english: Something pulses in your ears, driving a momentary prick of pain deep into your head; you realize it's the translation device, picking up on something else in the room, some other bit of imperceptible sound murmuring in the background. The voice interrupts it. "We know what thou desirest, Captain," it says. "To be a part of the events to come, thou shalt need the backing of the Houses. None comes to pass in this space without our blessing. Cry and bark as thou must, thou still requirest us."
units.italian: Qualcosa pulsa nelle tue orecchie, spingendo una punta di dolore in fondo alla testa; capisci che è il dispositivo di traduzione, che capta qualcos'altro nella stanza, un altro frammento di suono impercettibile che mormora sullo sfondo. La voce lo interrompe. "Sappiamo cosa desideri, capitano," dice. "Per essere parte degli eventi che verranno, ti servirà l'appoggio delle Casate. Nulla accade in questo spazio senza la nostra benedizione. Puoi strillare e abbaiare quanto vuoi, ma hai ancora bisogno di noi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"Then tell me what you want, and I'll decide if it's worth my time."|276|0
units.english: "Then tell me what you want, and I'll decide if it's worth my time."
units.italian: "Allora dimmi cosa vuoi, e deciderò se vale il mio tempo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"What is that sound?"|278|0
units.english: "What is that sound?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è questo suono?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	You feel it again, this time much more subtle. You can't shake the feeling that it's like something has noticed you. "Do not distract thyself, Captain," says the voice, and the pressure lifts.|279|0
units.english: You feel it again, this time much more subtle. You can't shake the feeling that it's like something has noticed you. "Do not distract thyself, Captain," says the voice, and the pressure lifts.
units.italian: Lo senti di nuovo, questa volta molto più tenue. Non riesci a toglierti di dosso la sensazione che qualcosa ti abbia notato. "Non distrarti, capitano," dice la voce, e la pressione si scioglie.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"Fine," you say, "just tell me what you want so I can decide if I want any more to do with you."|280|0
units.english: "Fine," you say, "just tell me what you want so I can decide if I want any more to do with you."
units.italian: "Va bene," dici, "dimmi solo cosa vuoi, così posso decidere se voglio ancora avere a che fare con te."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"Like before," the voice says, "when Sioeora asked their favor of thee, we've aught we wish to reclaim from the gyre of the Shroud. Nothing to upset thy delicate ethics - naught but trinkets from when the House was young. 'Twould make a fair consolation to us, and we would forgive thee, and thou wouldst know the beneficence of this House."|282|0
units.english: "Like before," the voice says, "when Sioeora asked their favor of thee, we've aught we wish to reclaim from the gyre of the Shroud. Nothing to upset thy delicate ethics - naught but trinkets from when the House was young. 'Twould make a fair consolation to us, and we would forgive thee, and thou wouldst know the beneficence of this House."
units.italian: "Come l'altra volta," dice la voce, "quando Sioeora ti chiese un favore, abbiamo qualcosa che vogliamo recuperare dal gorgo dello Shroud. Nulla che turbi la tua delicata etica: solo ninnoli di quando la Casa era giovane. Sarebbe per noi un giusto risarcimento, e ti perdoneremmo, e conosceresti la benevolenza di questa Casa."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"Certain some drone warship isn't going to come after me as soon as I grab your trinkets?" you say, recalling the experience with House Aqrabe. This seems to catch the voice off guard, if only a little, and it takes a moment before it replies. "Any encounter thou hast met once before, thou shouldst surely be unafraid of facing again."|285|0
units.english: "Certain some drone warship isn't going to come after me as soon as I grab your trinkets?" you say, recalling the experience with House Aqrabe. This seems to catch the voice off guard, if only a little, and it takes a moment before it replies. "Any encounter thou hast met once before, thou shouldst surely be unafraid of facing again."
units.italian: "Certo che qualche nave da guerra drone non mi verrà dietro appena prendo i tuoi ninnoli?" dici, ricordando l'esperienza con Casa Aqrabe. Questo sembra cogliere la voce di sorpresa, anche solo un poco, e passa un momento prima che risponda. "Qualunque incontro tu abbia già affrontato una volta, non dovresti certo temere di affrontarlo di nuovo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|label|286|0
units.english: not met solitude enforcers
units.italian: not met solitude enforcers

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"I don't appreciate being treated as disposable."|288|0
units.english: "I don't appreciate being treated as disposable."
units.italian: "Non apprezzo essere trattato come qualcosa di usa e getta."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"All right, I'll do it. But you'd better hold up your end of the bargain."|291|0
units.english: "All right, I'll do it. But you'd better hold up your end of the bargain."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo faccio. Ma è meglio che tu mantenga la tua parte dell'accordo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"I'm done with this."|293|0
units.english: "I'm done with this."
units.italian: "Ho chiuso con questa storia."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"Thou'rt not a tool to be thrown away, Captain, but to be cultivated, polished to a gleam. We would not send thee to thy death - what benefits the House from that? Return to the spaceport here when thou'rt ready to begin thy task."|295|0
units.english: "Thou'rt not a tool to be thrown away, Captain, but to be cultivated, polished to a gleam. We would not send thee to thy death - what benefits the House from that? Return to the spaceport here when thou'rt ready to begin thy task."
units.italian: "Non sei uno strumento da gettare via, capitano, ma da coltivare, lucidare fino a farlo brillare. Non ti manderemmo certo a morire: che vantaggio ne trarrebbe la Casa? Torna allo spazioporto qui quando sei pronto a cominciare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|log|299|0
units.english: Accepted an offer to take on an additional mission for House Myurej to retrieve Predecessor artifacts.
units.italian: Hai accettato di assumere per Casa Myurej una missione aggiuntiva per recuperare manufatti dei Predecessori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"We shall," says the voice, "we always do. Return to the spaceport when thou'rt ready to begin."|300|0
units.english: "We shall," says the voice, "we always do. Return to the spaceport when thou'rt ready to begin."
units.italian: "Lo faremo," dice la voce, "lo facciamo sempre. Torna allo spazioporto quando sei pronto a cominciare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|log|304|0
units.english: Declined to take on additional mission for House Myurej to retrieve Predecessor artifacts. Can return to the Raaqa-Kvelq-Ryuit spaceport to accept it at a later date.
units.italian: Hai rifiutato di assumere per Casa Myurej una missione aggiuntiva per recuperare manufatti dei Predecessori. Puoi tornare allo spazioporto di Raaqa-Kvelq-Ryuit per accettarla in un secondo momento.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	"As thou sayst," says the voice. "When thou changest thy mind, return to the spaceport here to begin."|305|0
units.english: "As thou sayst," says the voice. "When thou changest thy mind, return to the spaceport here to begin."
units.italian: "Come dici tu," dice la voce. "Quando cambi idea, torna allo spazioporto qui per cominciare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 4|	You exit the room with the screen and return to the landing pad with your ship.|307|0
units.english: You exit the room with the screen and return to the landing pad with your ship.
units.italian: Esci dalla stanza con lo schermo e torni alla piazzola con la tua nave.
